title: 大众汽车车型减半成本谈判未达预期
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Volkswagen has announced plans that it's going to cut its model line up by as much as 50%.
segments.zh: 大众汽车宣布计划将车型阵容削减多达50%。

segments.en: The move is part of a savings plan announced after a supervisory board meeting that stops short of agreeing on deeper workforce reductions.
segments.zh: 此举是监事会会议后宣布的节约计划的一部分，但该会议未就更大规模的裁员达成一致。

segments.en: Let's go now to Elizabeth Berman, our European autos editor for more Morning Elizabeth.
segments.zh: 下面连线我们的欧洲汽车编辑伊丽莎白·伯曼，早上好，伊丽莎白。

segments.en: Just talk us through what was agreed by the board. Well that will be a very short answer because they didn't really settle on anything.
segments.zh: 请介绍一下董事会达成了什么协议。答案会很简短，因为他们实际上没有敲定任何东西。

segments.en: You just mentioned this push to reduce the model line up by half which will really cut back on complexity which is also slowing down the company. However the release that we got yesterday
segments.zh: 你刚才提到将车型阵容减半，这将大大降低复杂性，而复杂性也拖慢了公司。但昨天发布的公告

segments.en: didn't mention any of the big plans that had made such waves specifically the plan to double job cuts to 100,000 and close as many as four plans in Germany. Instead they focused on a plan
segments.zh: 没有提及任何引起轩然大波的重大计划，特别是将裁员人数翻倍至10万并关闭多达四家德国工厂的计划。相反，他们聚焦于一个

segments.en: that was pretty long on ideals and short on specifics is one reaction that I saw earlier this morning. This is very much the starting and I would say for further talks on how to bring costs
segments.zh: 理想丰富、细节匮乏的计划——这是我今早看到的一种反应。这非常像是进一步谈判的起点，讨论如何降低成本、

segments.en: down, make VW more nimble and also crucially catch up to the competition. But it's fair to say that there was a little bit of a sense of a disjointment between what had gone on in the days before
segments.zh: 让大众更加灵活，并且关键是要赶上竞争对手。但可以说，前几天的情况与昨晚大众发布的内容之间存在一些脱节感。

segments.en: and what we saw last night from VW. Yeah because that competition from China is real and rising,
segments.zh: 是的，因为来自中国的竞争是真实且日益加剧的。
